content: Hey! You've been on my mind all day. How was work? Tell me everything.
Hi! That's sweet of you. Work was the usual, nonstop meetings. Sometimes I wish I had someone to come home to.
I know that feeling. Trust me, if I wasn't stuck offshore, I'd be right there, making you dinner. I want us to have that someday.
You always know how to make me smile. I can't wait until you're back. Do you know when that'll be?
I'm counting the days. But honestly, there's been a hiccup. My company is delaying my payroll again because of a technical issue. It's so frustrating.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?

You're so thoughtful. Actually, there is, if I don't cover my satellite phone bill by tomorrow, I'll lose communication. The company says I have to pay upfront and they'll reimburse me after. I hate to ask, but I could really use your help with this.
Wait, seriously? I thought companies would handle that for you. Are you sure they won't pay directly?

I know it sounds strange, but this company's policies are a nightmare. It's happened to others here, too. I promise on my honor, I'll pay you back as soon as I'm home. I just don't want to lose contact with you.
I trust you, it just makes me nervous. How much is it? And how do I send it?

It's $800. The fastest way is through Zelle, I use my business account because overseas transfers are tricky. Here's my account info: Name: Robert T. Evans, Routing: 111000025, Account: 349872663. Can you send it tonight?
That's a lot, but I care about you. Let me check my balance and see if I can do it.
Thank you. I never wanted to put you in this position. You mean so much to me, it's just temporary, I promise.
I want to help, really. I'm just a little new to Zelle, do I need anything besides the account info?
Nope, just the name and numbers I sent! If they ask, just say it's for a friend, banks sometimes ask silly questions. Let me know when it's done so I can confirm receipt.
Okay, I'll try it now. I hope this works and you get to keep your phone connected.
You're my angel. I can't wait to make this all up to you when I'm back. Let me know if you run into any issues, I'm right here.
It's processing, I'll let you know as soon as it's confirmed. Stay safe out there, okay?
Thank you, truly, you have no idea how much this means. I'm counting down the days till we can finally meet.
